name: io.github.leo9/stayforwork
title: StayForWork - Housing and Hotels for Travel Workers
description: Find extended-stay hotels and furnished housing near work assignments.

io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.usageNotes: Find hotels, motels and furnished housing for work trips lasting weeks or months. Provide a destination, dates and guests. Inspect hotels by name or returned property ID, and homes by a property reference returned by search. Some private hotel prices require sign-in on the website. Booking and payment happen outside the MCP tools; prices and estimates can change.
